Eligibility does not depend on persona descriptions or pending legacy claims. A separate active project reviewer is configured for the state/data review prerequisite. The documented source-digest domains and PRD trimming explain the differing source and PRD fingerprints. The Service-provided isolation facts establish that this Gold precedes candidates on the bundle. I relied on the supplied evidence and mechanical digest bindings; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or provide human attestation.
